content.text:
I'd go with the second one, B, the single list. I'm not very sure, and to be honest I'd still ask you or the bank before I put a shekel in.

What decided it: B is the only one where I could see something that isn't all shares. Under each name there's a little Hebrew label, "אשראי ואג"ח" or "כספי (שקלי)", and next to it "מניות 0%" or "מניות 5%". I know אג"ח, so that's where I'd start looking. A and C both open with "עוקב מדד s&p 500" in English letters, row after row of it. If I'd come on my own I'd have felt it wasn't for me and closed it.

**What I looked at, in order**
- **The top.** The title "כל המסלולים בכל החברות: שלוש אפשרויות" and the line "143 מסלולים של 12 חברות". I couldn't read the three bullets under it, the grey is too small. I caught "דמי הניהול... בין 0.50% ל־0.73%".
- **Option A ("מומלץ").** A long table, a row of buttons I didn't press, then groups: "עוקב מדד s&p 500", then "מניות", then "עוקב מדדי מניות". That's two screens of shares only, "מניות 99%, 100%". The bonds come only at the very end, in a small orange note: "אשראי ואג"ח (23)". That's the part I was looking for, and it's hidden.
- **Option B ("רשימה אחת מהזול ליקר").** Every row has a label saying what kind it is. I found "הראל גמל להשקעה אשראי ואג"ח", "מניות 5%", fees "0.54% מהחיסכון". "מנורה... כספי (שקלי)" had 0% shares. Then it said "עוד 129 מסלולים" and the list stopped.
- **Option C ("כמו א', ועוד תשואה עבר וגודל").** The first thing I saw was "13.79% 3 שנים". That stays with me, it sounds like a lot. But it's all S&P again. The pale line at the bottom says this is past returns and "לא אומרת מה יקרה בהמשך". So it's the same as my fund that fell. I didn't trust it. Sizes like "2.3 מיליארד ₪" don't tell me anything.

**What I didn't understand**
"s&p 500" (I'd read it out letter by letter), "עוקב מדדים - גמיש", "מט"ח", "מחקה", "מדד" in this sense, "מההפקדות" next to "מהחיסכון", and "קופה 13874", whatever that number is. Also the round rings and the clock icons. I didn't know what they meant, or why some numbers have a dotted underline.

**What bothered me**
- **Dark screen.** White and grey letters on black. The grey explanations were too pale and small for me even with my glasses.
- **The same words on every row.** "מניות", "מט"ח", "מהחיסכון", "מההפקדות", little dots and clocks, on each of the 143 rows. I read them again every time just to find the one number that's different. Once at the top would have been enough.
- **The rings.** The percent is written to the side, so I kept looking back and forth to match it to the colour. Turquoise and yellow on black are hard for me to tell apart anyway.
- **Too many buttons.** Three rows of them full of words I don't know made me anxious.
- **Nothing about the bank.** Nothing anywhere compares with my bank deposit, and nothing tells me if it's guaranteed. That's what I really wanted to know.

By the fourth screen I was tired. I only glanced at the end of C.
